facts.raw_span: 2 months of progressive proximal muscle weakness
difficulty combing her hair and rising from a chair
morning stiffness of both small hand joints lasting about 30 minutes
dysphagia for solids and liquids
without fever or weight loss
symmetric muscle strength of 4/5 in the upper limbs and 3/5 in the lower limbs
brisk reflexes more pronounced on the left
leukopenia (WBC 2.96 × 10^3/µL)
microcytic anemia (hemoglobin 10.4 g/dL)
elevated C-reactive protein (18.8 mg/L) and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (109.2 mm/hr)
bilateral sacroiliitis
thyroid ultrasound demonstrated a multinodular goiter consistent with thyroiditis
